headline: STAY at a 5.00 % assumed probability: exiting now pays off if you believe the incident "wstETH/stETH exchange rate -10% (oracle sees it), liquidations, then the largest competing holders exit first" has more than 5.19 % chance within 30 days; the yield spread over the ETH staking yield (Lido, 7 days), 1.37 % vs 2.24 %, is negative: it prices no default risk. Dominant dependency: exit liquidity shared with Steakhouse ETH in the same Morpho markets (its largest depositor leaving first cuts this exit by 5.71 %); wstETH collateral priced by "wstETH/stETH exchange rate": a market depeg is not seen by liquidations.
